VR.title: Qualcomm Announces Snapdragon Reality Elite, Its New Flagship XR Chipset
VR.summary: Qualcomm announced its new Snapdragon Reality Elite chipset, aiming to enhance the performance and efficiency of future XR headsets and glasses.

VR.title: XREAL AURA AR Glasses Get Fall Release Window, $1,500 Price Ceiling
VR.summary: XREAL AURA AR glasses, developed with Google and Qualcomm, are set for a fall release with a price not exceeding $1,500.

VR.title: Canon Reveals Concept Handheld MR Device, Glass Waveguide & Collaboration Software
VR.summary: Canon showcased a concept handheld mixed reality device and new XR collaboration software at Augmented World Expo, highlighting its advancements in XR technology.

VR.title: Xreal Aura Ships This Fall, With Snapdragon Reality Elite In Its Puck
VR.summary: Xreal Aura is now available for preorder, featuring Qualcomm's Snapdragon Reality Elite in its compute puck, with a fall launch expected.

VR.title: Qualcomm’s New Snapdragon Chip Paves the Way for More Compact XR Headsets and Glasses
VR.summary: Qualcomm unveiled its Snapdragon Reality Elite processor, designed to enable more compact and energy-efficient XR devices.

VR.title: Raven Prism Smart Glasses Announced with Unique Hot-swappable Battery
VR.summary: Raven Prism smart glasses were announced, featuring a unique hot-swappable battery system for all-day use.

AI.summary: Midjourney has introduced its first hardware product, a full-body ultrasound scanner, marking a significant shift from its AI image generation origins.

AI.title: Two-thirds of Americans think AI is advancing too quickly

NFL.summary: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles criticized his team for lacking effort during a game, expressing frustration over their performance.

NFL.title: Falcons sign P Matthew Hayball

NFL.summary: The Cowboys placed offensive lineman Matt Hennessy on season-ending injured reserve and signed three players from the UFL.
